metadata.desc: HTML/template to image rendering inside the AstrBot process, ready to be used as AstrBot's text-to-image endpoint without an extra container. Built on the official text-to-image service with an identical interface and behavior.

fonts.title: Render Fonts
fonts.subtitle: Provides fonts for text-to-image rendering without touching the upstream render logic. Font files live under fonts/ in the plugin data directory and take effect when the render process starts.

action.refreshHint: Rewrite the font config and reload rendering

warn.disabled: Fonts are disabled in the plugin config (fonts.enabled), so download and upload will not take effect.
warn.api: This AstrBot version does not support plugin page APIs (4.24.1 or newer is required). The font directory and config keys still work, but this page cannot download or upload fonts.

state.pending: Fonts not in effect yet, applied on the next render

installed.title: Installed fonts
installed.empty: The font directory is still empty. Upload a font or download one from a link to start.

specimen.title: Font specimen self-check
specimen.hint: The plugin's own renderer draws one line per selected family; with nothing selected it compares every installed font. If a line looks identical to the others, that font is not really in effect.
specimen.caption: Comparing {count} families: {list}

add.title: Add fonts
add.hint: Supports .ttf / .otf / .ttc files and checks that the file really is a font. You can also paste a direct link — when the name is left empty it is taken from the link. Use a GitHub proxy (e.g. the https://gh-proxy.com/ prefix) for large files.

project.desc: These fonts are organised around the layout needs of astrbot_plugin_qq_group_daily_analysis（群聊日常分析）: that plugin renders group chat reports into images and picks font families and weights per template. Each template below can be installed in one go.
project.hintBefore: Other text-to-image templates can use these fonts as well — as long as the font-family in the template matches the family name inside the font file. To install your own fonts, open the
project.hintAfter: tab and upload a file or paste a link.

templates.title: Download template fonts in one go

families.title: Single font family
families.hint: The list comes from the upstream project's T2I_FONTS.md; an installed family shows Delete instead of Download.

toast.busy: Another job is already running, please wait
toast.uploadUnsupported: This AstrBot version cannot upload from a page; use a download link instead
toast.uploadNoFamily: Uploaded, but no font family name was found. Check that the file is a valid font.
toast.refreshed: Font config rewritten; the render process restarts on demand
toast.allInstalled: Every font family is already installed
toast.nothingDelete: No font files are installed for this family
toast.armDeleteMany: Click again to delete the {count} font files of {name}
toast.armDownload: Click again to download {count} font families

error.generic: Request failed, see the AstrBot log
error.noBridge: The AstrBot plugin page bridge was not found. Open this page from the plugin page in the WebUI.
